question_text: Complete the following table with the information given in the passage.
stimulus: When we speak of wildlife, the first name that comes to mind is the tiger. The tiger belongs to the cat family, and in the Royal Bengal Tiger we have the largest and the most ferocious of cats. It is a magnificent animal, powerful and courageous. Now-a-days it is found only in the Sunderbans, though at one time they could be found in Sylhet, Chattogram Hill Tracts and the Madhupur Jungles as well. Unfortunately, howerver, greed and ignorance of some people have combined to nearly wipe out this majestic animal from Bangladesh. Tigers have been ruthlessly tracked and killed for their skins. The Cheeta (leopard) is often compared with the tiger in courage. It is one of the swiftest animals in the world. The spotted leopard of Bangladesh is one of the most beautiful of animals also, and so has not escaped the hunters eyes. Talking of good climbers, we have in our country some of the best. The most common and certainly the most amusing is the monkey. Once a common sight even in the cities, it is now found in large numbers in the villages. These lovable little creatures are subject to some of the cruellest treatment at the hands of man. The rarest monkey found in Bangladesh is the ‘Lajjaboti Banor’. It has a small round head with large affectionate eyes. The Lajjaboti Banor is so called because it is very shy. It lives deep in the jungles and comes out of hiding only at night. guide_solution: Complete the table: (1) the cat family; (2) in the Sundarbans; (3) for their skins; (4) is one of the swiftest animals; (5) The Lajjaboti Banor.
